This property is located in Sandestin® Golf and Beach Resort. *
1379 Ravens Run at Laurel Grove brought to you by Beach Blue Properties.
(2) 6-Seat Golf Carts, Resort Tram!

“Plane Retreat” is a most delightful 4BR lakefront cottage located in the picturesque neighborhood of Laurel Grove at the Resort. With sunny family areas, private niches, and charm galore, this is the perfect home for a relaxing vacation. Sit awhile on the back porch daybed overlooking the lake; or unwind on the southern style front porch. This charming residence will take you away from it all!

Laurel Grove is designed with families in mind. Located at the Resort, Laurel Grove is within a few minutes golf cart ride to the beach. There is a Clubhouse within short walking distance that features a tropical swimming pool, hot tub, fitness room, and outdoor grills. Catch and release fishing is permitted in the lakes and ponds at Laurel Grove. Miles of walking trails, golf courses, tennis, boating, restaurants, boutique shopping, movie theaters, and the sugar white beach are just a few amenities of the Resort. You will enjoy spinning all over the resort by golf cart and take a quick ride to the beach. “Plane Retreat” provides guests with two 6-Seat golf carts.

The first floor of our two story home features the main living and dining areas, a powder bath, and a large master bedroom suite with a king bed and a private master bath. The second floor offers an additional master suite with a king bed and a private bath. A third guest bedroom is furnished with king bed and provides access to a “closet bedroom” with a twin bed. A fourth guest bedroom is designed with two twin beds, and offers access to an additional “closet bedroom” with a twin bed. There is a hallway bathroom to service nearby guest bedrooms. All of the bedrooms and closet sleeping spaces are furnished with smart HDTV’s. For your convenience, there is a stackable washer and dryer, and wifi is complimentary. Only two cars may park at the home and street parking is not permitted by the HOA.

You will enjoy every minute of your time at 1379 Ravens Run. Hope to see you at the beach!

*Sandestin® is a registered trademark of Sandestin Investments, LLC and is used for location purposes only.
CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking.

NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, transportation fee (for select properties), processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located on the waterfront, this vacation home is in Laurel Grove, a neighborhood in Miramar Beach. While the natural beauty of Miramar Beach and Destin Beaches can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Jet skiing and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with ecotours and cycling nearby.
